_about: Scenario tree (owner, 2026-11-20): whatever a person comes in with, the route is covered — what to do in what order, which tools, roughly what it costs. Source: docs/SCENARIOS.md (A–N, capability codes, intake by kind of video), SPEC §0 (scenario = template compiled to stages), docs/research/service-costs-2026-11-20.md (cost constants). Read by vp.scenarios; never by a model directly. Step fields: id, title {ru,en}, executor (code | model | human_gate | service:<capability>), command (`vp ...` when built, `planned:<capability>` when not, `mcp:<tool>` for the claude.ai connector, null for dialog work), needs [capabilities], optional, cost {qty, factors}, fallback {title, executor, command, needs, level} or blocked_note. A scenario step {"use": "<lib id>", ...} takes the library step and overrides its fields.

voice_chars_per_min.unit: characters of Russian voice-over per minute

tts_usd_per_char.source: ElevenLabs API TTS Multilingual v2/v3 $0.08 per 1k chars, elevenlabs.io/pricing/api (2026-11-20); service-costs §1.2

image_usd.source: planning figure, service-costs §2 (FLUX.2 pro $0.03, Nano Banana 2.1 1K $0.034, GPT-Image-2 medium $0.041–0.053); premium models $0.13–0.21 not used here

ai_video_s_per_min.unit: seconds of AI clip per minute of video

ai_video_usd_per_s.source: service-costs §3: budget tier (Veo 3.1 Lite, Gen-4 Turbo) $0.05 to top tier (Veo 3.1 with audio) $0.40

avatar_usd_per_min.source: service-costs §4: HeyGen API Avatar IV photo $3, digital twin $4; Sync lipsync-2-pro $5 (HeyGen rate near-official)

dubbing_usd_per_min.source: ElevenLabs API Dubbing v1 no watermark $0.50, v2 $2.20, elevenlabs.io/pricing/api (2026-11-20); service-costs §1.2

stock_usd.source: service-costs §5: Pexels/Pixabay free; Storyblocks $24/mo is a subscription, not counted per video

quantities.output_min: minutes of the finished video (--minutes, default 1)
quantities.source_hours: hours of source recording (--source-hours; default from the scenario's defaults.source_hours)
quantities.ai_video_s: seconds of AI clips (--ai-video-seconds; default output_min × ai_video_s_per_min)
